# omniddi_ipam_container (Resource)

Manages an IPAM container: an address block that groups subnets and other containers. Writes are synchronous. Creating a container adopts any existing networks that fall inside its CIDR.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omniddi_ipam_node" "ipv4_root" {
  protocol = "IPv4"
}

resource "omniddi_ipam_container" "corp" {
  parent_id   = data.omniddi_ipam_node.ipv4_root.id
  name        = "corp"
  cidr        = "10.0.0.0/8"
  description = "Corporate address space"
  owner       = "netops"

  deletion_protection = true

  tags = {
    env = "prod"
  }
}

resource "omniddi_ipam_container" "datacenter" {
  parent_id  = omniddi_ipam_container.corp.id
  name       = "datacenter"
  cidr       = "10.10.0.0/16"
  depends_on = [omniddi_ipam_container.corp]

  reparent_children_on_destroy = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) The address block the container covers, as a CIDR whose address is the network address, for example `10.0.0.0/16` or `2001:db8::/32`. It must sit inside the parent and cannot be a single host. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Name of the container.
- `parent_id` (Number) Id of the parent `FAMILY` or `CONTAINER` node (see the `omniddi_ipam_node` data source). OmniDDI places a container under the deepest container that holds its CIDR, so use the immediate parent. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `business_unit_id` (Number) Business unit of the container. Inherited from the parent when not set. Changing a configured value forces a new resource.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Refuse to delete the object while true. Set to false and apply before destroying. Defaults to `true`.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Skip the provider's check that refuses to delete a container that still has child networks. OmniDDI itself still refuses unless `reparent_children_on_destroy` is set, and never deletes children. Defaults to `false`.
- `owner` (String) Owner label.
- `reparent_children_on_destroy` (Boolean) When true, deleting the container moves its direct child networks to the container's own parent instead of being refused. Children are never deleted. Defaults to `false`.
- `tags` (Map of String) Single-valued OmniDDI tags. Tag definitions must already exist. Merged with provider `default_tags`.
- `tags_list` (Map of List of String) Multi-valued (list) OmniDDI tags. Tag definitions must already exist.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `vlan` (String) VLAN label.

### Read-Only

- `created_on` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) The OmniDDI numeric identifier.
- `prefix_length` (Number) Prefix length of the container.
- `protocol` (String) `IPv4` or `IPv6`.
- `status` (String) `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE` or `DEPRECATED`.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) All single-valued tags on the object, including those inherited from provider `default_tags`.
- `updated_on` (String) Last update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import omniddi_ipam_container.corp 42
terraform import omniddi_ipam_container.corp 10.0.0.0/8
```
